question: What outcome regarding age and death follows from abstaining from food by day?
premises: Age and death are named together
inference: By abstaining from food during the day, one will overcome age and death
uncertainties: The exact sense of gamiṣyate with vayo-mṛtyuṃ is interpretive; it may mean going beyond or reaching the end of age and death
plain_english: By not eating during the day, one will go beyond age and death.
